content.text: The log has about 200 lines in several date and amount formats, so I'll write a parser that flags anything it can't read, then compute the tables from its output.

input.content:
import re
from collections import defaultdict
from datetime import date
from decimal import Decimal

SRC = r"C:\Users\<user>\AppData\Local\Temp\prompt-evals-session-hkbsqfgq\personal_expenses.txt"
YEAR = 2026
MONTHS = [6, 7, 8]
MONTH_NAMES = {"jun": 6, "june": 6, "jul": 7, "july": 7, "aug": 8, "august": 8}
HEADER_LINES = 3

DATE_PATTERNS = [
    ("iso", re.compile(r"\b(\d{4})-(\d{1,2})-(\d{1,2})\b")),
    ("mdy", re.compile(r"\b(\d{1,2})/(\d{1,2})/(\d{2,4})\b")),
    ("md", re.compile(r"\b(\d{1,2})/(\d{1,2})\b")),
    ("mmdd", re.compile(r"\b(\d{2})-(\d{2})\b")),
    ("mname", re.compile(r"\b(Jun|June|Jul|July|Aug|August)\.?\s+(\d{1,2})\b", re.I)),
]

CATEGORY_RULES = [
    ("UNCATEGORIZED", ["zelle", "paypal transfer", "venmo", "atm cash"]),
    ("Subscriptions & bills", ["icloud", "amazon prime", "netflix", "spotify premium", "planet fitness", "xfinity", "verizon"]),
    ("Entertainment", ["spotify concert", "steam", "ticketmaster", "amc theatres", "bowl-o-rama"]),
    ("Groceries", ["trader joe", "aldi", "kroger", "costco", "whole foods"]),
    ("Eating out & coffee", ["local coffee", "starbucks", "chipotle", "mcdonald", "panera", "sushi kame", "thai orchid", "rustic tap", "luigi", "bagel corner"]),
    ("Gas & car", ["shell", "chevron", "bp gas", "jiffy lube"]),
    ("Transport & travel", ["lyft", "uber", "city parking", "airport parking", "hertz", "delta air", "marriott"]),
    ("Shopping", ["amazon", "best buy", "target", "old navy", "ikea", "home depot", "barnes & noble", "rei"]),
    ("Health & pharmacy", ["riverside physical", "dr. hensley", "walgreens", "cvs"]),
]
CATEGORY_PATTERNS = [(cat, [re.compile(r"\b" + re.escape(k)) for k in kws]) for cat, kws in CATEGORY_RULES]


def categorize(merchant):
    m = merchant.lower()
    for cat, pats in CATEGORY_PATTERNS:
        if any(p.search(m) for p in pats):
            return cat
    return None


def parse(line):
    s = line
    dates = []
    for kind, pat in DATE_PATTERNS:
        for m in pat.finditer(s):
            dates.append((kind, m.groups()))
        s = pat.sub(" ", s)
    if len(dates) != 1:
        return None, f"{len(dates)} date matches"
    kind, g = dates[0]
    try:
        if kind == "iso":
            y, mo, d = int(g[0]), int(g[1]), int(g[2])
        elif kind == "mdy":
            mo, d, y = int(g[0]), int(g[1]), int(g[2])
            y = y + 2000 if y < 100 else y
        elif kind == "mname":
            mo, d, y = MONTH_NAMES[g[0].lower()], int(g[1]), YEAR
        else:
            mo, d, y = int(g[0]), int(g[1]), YEAR
        dt = date(y, mo, d)
    except (ValueError, KeyError) as e:
        return None, f"bad date {dates[0]}: {e}"

    amts = list(re.finditer(r"\d{1,4}\.\d{2}\b", s))
    if len(amts) != 1:
        return None, f"{len(amts)} amount matches"
    amt = Decimal(amts[0].group())
    if re.search(r"-\$\d", line):
        amt = -amt
    s = s[:amts[0].start()] + " " + s[amts[0].end():]

    merchant = s.replace("$", " ").replace("(", " ").replace(")", " ").replace("|", " ")
    merchant = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", merchant).strip(" -,:")
    if not merchant:
        return None, "no merchant"
    return {"date": dt, "merchant": merchant, "amount": amt, "refund": amt < 0}, None


lines = open(SRC, encoding="utf-8").read().splitlines()
txns, problems = [], []
for no, text in enumerate(lines, start=1):
    if no <= HEADER_LINES or not text.strip():
        continue
    t, err = parse(text)
    if err:
        problems.append((no, text, err))
        continue
    t["line"] = no
    t["category"] = categorize(t["merchant"])
    if t["category"] is None:
        problems.append((no, text, f"no category rule for '{t['merchant']}'"))
        t["category"] = "UNMATCHED"
    txns.append(t)
